entries.en: All right, all right. Fuck off.
I couldn't pick up… I was busy.
Oh, it's you… Yeah, let's say… What?!
entries.ro: Oh, tu ești… Da, să zicem… Ce?!

entries.en: You think only you got problems?! Let me fuckin' live!
entries.ro: Crezi că numai tu ai probleme?! Lasă-mă dracu' să trăiesc!

entries.en: Just so it don't hurt, OK?
Kitten, you brave or just fuckin' crazy?
entries.ro: Pisicuță, ești curajoasă sau doar nebună de-a binelea?
entries.ro_m: Pisicuță, ești curajos sau doar nebun de-a binelea?

entries.en: Listen, I ain't explaining anything… Asshole…
Fuck you! I don't give a shit! Idiot! Fuckin' narcissist!
entries.ro: Du-te-n pula mea! Mă doare-n cur! Idiotule! Narcisist nenorocit!
